clue.text: Short not loud 10

indicators.note: not loud says the letter for loud must be left out of the word before it

parts.note: short means brief
F is the musical abbreviation for forte, loud

explanation.surface: A cryptic instruction to say something briefly and quietly, pointing at another clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE, so the definition is simply a kind of cheese. Removing F (loud) from BRIEF leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Brie is a soft French cow's-milk variety, an example of the dairy product named at 10.

clue.text: Encourage search to create bouffant look

parts.note: to back someone is to support or encourage them
to comb an area is to search it thoroughly

explanation.surface: Backing a hunt to produce a voluminous hairstyle.
explanation.definitionFit: Teasing hair by combing towards the roots is how a puffed-up hairstyle is made.

clue.text: One has gone too far if one reaches these

definitions.text: One has gone too far if one reaches these

parts.words: One has gone too far if one reaches these
parts.note: reaching the furthest limits literally is going too far, and figuratively means overdoing something

explanation.surface: A reflection on how far is too far.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to the furthest limits of anything is the idiom for overdoing it.

clue.text: Compares an unusual 10

indicators.note: unusual tells us the letters of the preceding words appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Someone compares an odd specimen of the dairy product to others.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascarpone is a soft Italian cream variety, an example of the dairy product named at 10.

clue.text: Brother sits on top of yob! Is he behaving like a 19A?

indicators.note: in a down clue the word above sits on what follows, so it comes first

parts.note: a monk is a brother of a religious order

indicators.note: behaving suggests the letters act up and rearrange
top of picks the opening letter of yob

explanation.surface: A monk is perched above a lout who is acting like an ape.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 across is GREAT APE. 'Behaving' does double duty in the surface, but its job is the anagram of Y + IS HE.
explanation.definitionFit: Ape-like behaviour is mischievous and monkey-like, so the adjective describes acting as a primate would.

clue.text: Train revolutionary European conscript — leaving college, one may write about class struggles

definitions.text: one may write about class struggles

parts.note: to school someone is to train them

indicators.note: revolutionary says these letters are overturned into a new order
leaving says the college letter goes out of conscript

explanation.surface: A trainee revolutionary European recruit quits college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Class struggles' means a class's weaknesses, which an inspector writes up in a report.
explanation.definitionFit: An official who assesses teaching writes reports on how well a class is performing.

clue.text: Run out lines of new style corsets

parts.note: RO is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for run out
L is short for line, so LL is lines
o' is a short form of of, as in will-o'-the-wisp
NS is the abbreviation for New Style, the Gregorian calendar dating

explanation.surface: A shop runs out of a line of modern foundation garments.
explanation.walkthrough: New Style (NS) is the dating of the Gregorian calendar, adopted in Britain in 1752.
explanation.definitionFit: These are elasticated girdles or foundation garments pulled on by rolling, a kind of corset.

clue.text: Old money will secure the essence of full luxury

indicators.note: will secure says the coins hold the other letters inside

parts.note: pence is money

indicators.note: the essence of takes the heart of full, its middle letters

explanation.surface: Old money brings with it the essence of a luxurious life.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulence is lavish wealth and luxuriousness, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Best cut off time for start of duty

indicators.note: for signals that one letter stands in for another

parts.note: to elide is to cut off or omit a sound

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of duty

explanation.surface: The best time to finish is when duty starts.
explanation.definitionFit: The elite are the best of a group, the pick of the bunch.

clue.text: Division of territory is unable to return 50%

parts.note: unable, as cannot, gives its first half here

indicators.note: return 50% says half of the word for unable, its back half, is turned around

parts.note: the second half of cannot

explanation.surface: A region of land cannot hand back half of something.
explanation.walkthrough: "Is unable to" gives CANNOT; its last half, NOT, is turned back to TON.
explanation.definitionFit: A canton is an administrative subdivision of a country, as in Switzerland.

clue.text: Greeting with hesitation one 10

parts.note: hallo is a greeting
um is a sound of hesitation
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone greets, hesitates, and points to a single cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Halloumi is a firm Cypriot grilling variety, an example of the dairy product named at 10.

clue.text: Child's pronounced quiet smile — saying this

indicators.note: pronounced says we write a word that sounds like the one meant

parts.note: ease means rest, quiet, as in at ease

explanation.surface: A child gives a broad silent grin.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe-s of Child's is a link meaning has. The word said for the camera stretches the lips.
explanation.definitionFit: Photographers ask subjects to say this word because its long vowel stretches the lips into a grin.

clue.text: Dressing first of littlies in knitted bootees is old hat

indicators.note: in places the chosen letter inside the rearranged knitted letters
knitted means worked together into a new shape, so the letters of bootees are rearranged
first of picks the opening letter of littlies

explanation.surface: Baby bootees as a dressing for the little ones are out of fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of BOOTEES (OBSOETE) takes L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something old hat is outdated, no longer in use or fashion.

clue.text: They enlighten worshippers downgrading God

indicators.note: downgrading means the letter for God is moved lower in the word

parts.note: deifiers are those who make gods of, so worship
D is short for Deus, Latin for God

explanation.surface: Those who enlighten others are worshippers who have demoted the deity.
explanation.walkthrough: D moves from first to second place in DEIFIERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Edifiers are people who instruct or improve others morally or intellectually.

clue.text: 10 keep following music broadcast

indicators.note: following says the stronghold comes after
broadcast means spoken over the air, so we use a word that sounds the same

parts.note: rock is a style of music
a keep is a fort, the stronghold of a castle

explanation.surface: A cheese station keeps playing music after the broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE. ROQUE sounds like ROCK.
explanation.definitionFit: Roquefort is a French blue ewe's-milk variety, an example of the dairy product named at 10.

clue.text: Some hips wobble when back is bent

indicators.note: back says the concealed letters are read in the opposite direction
some says only part of the words hips wobble is used

explanation.surface: Hips wobble when a person's back is curved.
explanation.walkthrough: SWOB sits within 'hips wobble' and reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To bow is to bend forward, so a figure that bows is bent over.

clue.text: Platform for one who stands for progress on the surface?

definitions.text: Platform for one who stands for progress on the surface?

parts.words: Platform for one who stands for progress on the surface?
parts.note: it sounds like a political soapbox, but is a board a person stands on while towed over a lake or sea

explanation.surface: A political stage for a candidate championing superficial progress.
explanation.definitionFit: A board worn on the foot lets someone stand while being towed across a lake or sea.

clue.text: Force English volunteers into 10

parts.note: F is the physics abbreviation for force
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Pressing English volunteers into the cheese service.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Feta is a crumbly Greek sheep's-milk variety, an example of the dairy product named at 10.

clue.text: Possible outcome of base life

indicators.note: outcome of says the result comes from reworking the letters of base life

explanation.surface: A plausible result of living a low life.
explanation.definitionFit: Feasible means achievable or practicable, a synonym.

clue.text: PS: Day in port, mostly quiet

indicators.note: in says the day letter is placed inside the harbour name

parts.note: Aden is a port in Yemen

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: dumb means silent, quiet

explanation.surface: A postscript recalls a quiet day spent in harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A postscript is an addition at the end of a letter, and that is what this Latin word means.

clue.text: Henry, with money at last, equips new build

indicators.note: new tells us these letters are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: H is the SI symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of money

explanation.surface: Henry, finally with cash, buys equipment for a new building.
explanation.definitionFit: Build in the sense of body shape is a synonym, someone's bodily frame and form.

clue.text: Extinguishes French completely after rising up around centre of Carcassonne

indicators.note: after puts the French word after the other piece
rising in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards
around says the French word encloses the middle letter

parts.note: tout is French for completely

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letter of the eleven in Carcassonne

explanation.surface: French firefighters douse a fire around the centre of Carcassonne.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rising' means read upwards. Carcassonne has eleven letters, so its centre is the sixth.
explanation.definitionFit: To put out a fire or light is to quench or extinguish it, a phrasal verb synonym.

clue.text: Primate's endless desire to swallow a beer say

indicators.note: to swallow says the shortened word takes the other letters inside it
endless means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: greed is a desire
tap is beer drawn from a particular cask, a sense listed in Chambers

explanation.surface: A primate's insatiable appetite leads it to gulp down a beer.
explanation.walkthrough: GREE (greed less D) swallows A TAP. The 's in the definition stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorillas, chimpanzees and orangutans are large primates grouped under this name.

clue.text: 10 sites university department in Indian state

indicators.note: in says the other letters are placed inside the state

parts.note: Goa is a state on the west coast of India

explanation.surface: A cheese locates a university faculty in Goa.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Gouda is a mild Dutch variety named after a town, an example of the dairy product named at 10.

clue.text: Guarantee runs out in middle of week

indicators.note: in places the shuffled letters within the central letters
middle of takes the central pair from week
out suggests the letters of runs are put out of order

explanation.surface: A promise that a supply runs out by Wednesday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Week' has four letters, so its middle is a pair of letters, and the scrambled 'runs' goes between them.
explanation.definitionFit: To guarantee something is to make certain of it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: In Paris one location surrounding most of its island is pristine

parts.note: un is French for one

indicators.note: surrounding says the place word goes around the trimmed island

parts.note: a spot is a location

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Paris's own island is the Île de la Cité; île is French for island

explanation.surface: A Parisian site around the Île de la Cité is untouched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In Paris' says the words are French, so one is UN and the island is ÎLE, the Île de la Cité. 'Most of' leaves IL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pristine is undamaged and untouched, in its original condition.

clue.text: Bovine delouser unknown in old time

indicators.note: in says the unknown is placed inside the combination

parts.note: bird is slang for a prison sentence, time inside
X is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A cattle pest-remover appears from nowhere in the past.
explanation.definitionFit: This African bird, also called an oxpecker, picks ticks and lice off cattle.

clue.text: Noble artist becomes involved in stoic art movement

indicators.note: becomes involved in places the painter inside the rearranged letters
movement says the letters of stoic art move around

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: An aristocratic painter joins a school of art devoted to Stoicism.
explanation.walkthrough: RA goes inside ARISTOCT, the anagram of STOIC ART.
explanation.definitionFit: A noble is a member of the aristocracy, a titled person of high rank.

clue.text: Eastern block 10

parts.note: a dam is a block on a river

explanation.surface: A block of cheese from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is CHEESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Edam is a mild Dutch variety sold in red wax, an example of the dairy product named at 10.
